<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #47230

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

when URL scheme is `ks3`, use ks3 SDK rather than AWS SDK. Note that a main difference is ks3 SDK does not expose context on API https://github.com/ks3sdklib/aws-sdk-go/issues/29 , so I manually set a 5 minutes timeout on HTTP client.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
```
|  30001 | ks3://data0/test.item_core.10*.csv?access-key=xxxxxx&secret-access-key=xxxxxx&endpoint=http%3a%2f%2fks3-cn-beijing-internal.ksyuncs.com&force-path-style=false&region=Beijing&provider=ks
| `test`.`item_core` |      112 |            | finished | 158.8GB          |      11100000 |                | 2023-10-09 05:27:28.744758 | 2023-10-09 05:27:31.897201 | 2023-10-09 05:50:52.899005 | root@%     |
```
- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->  

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
None
```

issue_context.title: Due to kingsoft s3 has different hebaviour with AWS s3, we should use k3s SDK when interact with it
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Maybe add `ks3://` as external storage backend scheme, and switch to https://github.com/ks3sdklib/aws-sdk-go
comments: /cc @Leavrth WDYT? the developer of ks3 says https://github.com/ks3sdklib/aws-sdk-go is actively maintained.

review_comments: if global sort upload a 10g+ file, if failed, is retry time included?
Do we need to check it when users do not need to use the put/delete permissions?

No.

These logic should be same as s3 backend.
the "aws" package (ks3 SDK) in this file does not have that function. And I don't want to import AWS SDK to let the reader clearly see we only use ks3 SDK
